name: Plant sitter
summary: The apartment's plants on a drawn windowsill, living on real time: each droops and yellows as days pass its watering schedule, tap one and water it and the can tips over it, and before summer each plant gets someone to take it home.
useWhen: 'who watered the basil last, it looks sad'
the plants are dying again lol
who's taking the plants home for the summer
keeping the apartment plants alive between roommates
a reminder that the monstera exists
dontUseWhen: a rotating chore schedule for the whole apartment (use chore-wheel)
dividing up shared things when the lease ends (use lease-divvy)

plants.description: 1 to 5 plants: name, kind (monstera, pothos, basil, cactus, snake), water every n days, days since last watered, who watered it, who is taking it for the summer, and a short line
